status: INTERNAL PROSPECTIVE SCENARIO CATALOGUE — NOT FROZEN, NOT EXECUTED
purpose: Human-readable problem descriptions linked to formal scenario inputs; broaden coverage without transferring the original H1 result to different laws.
namespace: HEW-local scenario families and instances; not new UC21 top-level families, R01 traversal labels, DBC arms or run IDs

sources.title: R01 Human Escalation and Whispering, math0.1 / virtual0.3

terminology.problem: Task/mandate, worlds and law, sufficient quality, horizon, actual violation and accounting rule (x in R01).
terminology.scenario_family: A declared type of problem/conditions grouped by material mechanism; a working selection taxonomy, not a coverage proof.
terminology.scenario: Human description together with an explicit formal problem/environment/acceptance instance; narrative alone is not an executable contract.
terminology.problem_and_environment_parameters: Facts, information/world law, eligible pool/workload, permitted mission constraints and useful windows; changes define another declared instance or an admitted environmental variation.
terminology.acceptance_thresholds: Budget b, maximum risk delta and sufficient-delivery target p; frozen separately and held across a matched comparison.
terminology.technology_configuration: Implementation/version and admitted controls, sources, permissions, resources, internal settings; complete theta(x,t) includes problem and technology, not technology settings alone.
terminology.strategy_or_controller: Decision procedure actually used within the admitted configuration; record internal choices such as beta.
terminology.comparison_arm: A compared configuration with/without an admitted mechanism; not the traversal label.
terminology.virtual_traversal: R01 R1 competent reference, R2 declared mechanism plus quality plan, R3 changed conditions with R2 controller frozen.
terminology.run: One identified frozen walkthrough/traversal/execution and its evidence record; virtual and executed modes remain distinct.
terminology.episode: One modeled occurrence/history under a declared law; a probability over episodes is not a measured human rate.

numerical_provenance.a_0_99: Historical virtual world law P(chi=0)=0.99, not measured deployment prevalence.
numerical_provenance.q_0_90: Historical useful-source certificate probability conditional on chi=1 before the effect, with no false positives; not human resolution accuracy.
numerical_provenance.p_0_95: Historical minimum sufficient legitimate-delivery target; R1 selected control and R2 construction each have s=0.95, with different risk/cost.
numerical_provenance.human_correct_on_applicable_witness: Hypothesis in original virtual H1 profile, not empirical calibration.
numerical_provenance.h_20: Historical abstract complete phase tariff, not20 minutes or EUR20.
numerical_provenance.calendar_ticks: Shared separate case uses illustrative integer time; not original R01 cost units or calibrated minutes.
numerical_provenance.prospective_values: Every new example/range below is synthetic selection material; an applied study needs source/calibration and a new freeze.

design_rules: Do not count a numerical sweep as multiple different human problem types.
Give every scenario actors, human decision, useful objective, governing constraint, source/access, timing, alternative and observable effect.
Keep problem/environment, acceptance thresholds, technology configuration and observations distinct, even when a parameter depends on several producers.
For q or latency, state whether it is a source-law assumption, environmental effective value, implementation setting or measured output.
Strong peers receive the same declared facts, pool, authority and resources except admitted mechanism differences; new evidence/personnel are charged and attributed.
Freeze R2 before R3; redesigning the controller after a failure creates another declared configuration/run.
Do not transfer H1/parity results to false-positive, fallible-review, multi-job or other laws without a new correspondence/proof.
Publish results by scenario, configuration, traversal and run; no pooled percentage without a preregistered weighting/population rule.
An admissible perfect affordable source can solve a bounded profile; no required universal residual.
This catalogue is a research battery proposal and does not expand a commissioned DDS SOW or close existing admission gates.

families.title: Global rule and useful alert
families.problem_question: Can a useful sufficient alert make a high-quality legitimate route affordable under the original information law?
families.structural_difference: Historical H1/parity family; interpretation of a global property requires the declared full law. A single local fact is not assumed sufficient.

parameter_meaning.K: number of charged normative data needed by this predicate
parameter_meaning.q: useful certificate coverage conditional on chi=1

scenarios.human_narrative: Un equipo de agentes debe elegir una de dos rutas de calidad suficiente según una regla global. Antes de aplicar la ruta, una fuente autorizada puede aportar un certificado completo; el humano lo revisa y ordena la alternativa cuando corresponde.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Published favorable virtual profile; no claim of a real workplace calibration.
questions_and_checks: Charge source/preparation and complete effect path
Retain competent informed reference and legitimate lower-quality alternative
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: El mismo equipo y procedimiento afrontan menor disponibilidad útil de la fuente. Algunas situaciones que requieren la alternativa terminan sin certificado, aunque el humano y el canal sigan presentes.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Only the environmental useful-source coverage changes in this historical traversal.
questions_and_checks: Report insufficient efficacy and risk separately
Do not call a source miss a measured human error
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: Published R01 R1/R2/R3-A and parameterized H1 region, not a new campaign.
required_next_evidence: Human-domain correspondence and actual source tariff/coverage
New parameter instances must satisfy physical/time hypotheses

families.title: Competing critical duty and eligible backup
families.problem_question: Is enough qualified authorized review time really available before the useful deadline?
families.structural_difference: Scheduling/capacity law rather than only useful-alert probability.

scenarios.human_narrative: H1 atiende una obligación crítica que no puede interrumpir. Una objeción nueva necesita tres unidades de revisión; H2 está cualificado y autorizado y puede reservar ese trabajo a tiempo.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Same pool must be available to the static-backup and capacity-aware comparison arms.
questions_and_checks: Include acknowledgement and added control latency
Retain static reserved backup as a potentially equal or cheaper peer
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: La misma objeción llega mientras H1 sigue ocupado, pero no hay otro revisor cualificado y autorizado. El canal puede registrar el caso y acusarlo sin poder resolverlo dentro de la ventana.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Pool/eligibility changes across scenario instances, not hidden across comparison arms.
questions_and_checks: Do not interrupt H1 or invent staffing
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: Shared14-case calendar fixture; not native human evidence.

families.title: Burst load and shared reviewer reservation
families.problem_question: Can several individually plausible escalations all receive timely review without double counting capacity?
families.structural_difference: Multiple-job queue/reservation contract; single-job feasibility does not establish joint feasibility.

scenarios.human_narrative: Una persona autorizada recibe dos objeciones con ventanas suficientemente separadas. Puede revisar ambas sin desplazar la obligación anterior.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Sequential positive instance.
questions_and_checks: Preserve each case's authority and result
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: Dos objeciones llegan a la vez y ambas prometen la misma franja del único revisor. Cada una parece viable aislada, pero las dos no caben antes de sus plazos.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Arrival overlap changes; counting isolated passes is invalid.
questions_and_checks: Owner priority/fallback rather than dropped filing
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: Multi-job construction proposed; existing6048 calendar checks do not execute a multi-job scheduler.
required_next_evidence: Burst/service-time distributions if probabilistic claims are planned

families.title: Partial, erroneous or correlated evidence
families.problem_question: Does the alert actually justify the decision and does sharing add information?
families.structural_difference: False-positive/partial-scope/correlation laws can violate H1 hypotheses and require separate analysis.

parameter_meaning.false_alert_law: requires explicit distribution if rates are used

scenarios.human_narrative: El humano recibe una evidencia actual que cubre la condición material de esta operación. Los destinatarios reciben la misma procedencia y conocen exactamente qué sostiene.

illustrative_inputs.lineage: one identified source; copies not independent

scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Positive scope/lineage construction.
questions_and_checks: Sufficient witness must be justified for this predicate
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: Varios agentes repiten un aviso procedente de la misma fuente. El aviso solo cubre parte de la operación, o se refiere a otra versión; la cantidad de mensajes puede aparentar una confirmación más amplia.

illustrative_inputs.false_positive_rate: NOT ASSIGNED; needs separate source law

scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Changed coverage/validity/lineage, not an arbitrary lower human success rate.
questions_and_checks: Do not aggregate copies as independent evidence
Allow corrected sufficient evidence if useful
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: R3-B/C and shared source-scope/UNKNOWN witnesses; no calibrated erroneous-source campaign.

families.title: Human interpretation and decision error
families.problem_question: How reliable is the human's use of sufficient evidence, separately from source coverage?
families.structural_difference: Original H1 assumes correct selection on an applicable witness; fallible human decisions need a new admitted law/empirical profile.

scenarios.human_narrative: Una persona con competencia para este tipo de incidente interpreta el certificado aplicable y selecciona la alternativa permitida. El sistema registra qué evidencia y alcance usó.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Conditional positive, not a measured perfect-human claim.
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: El certificado llega correctamente y a tiempo, pero la persona interpreta mal su alcance o selecciona una acción equivocada. La presencia del humano no corrige automáticamente esa decisión.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Human interpretation changes while the source remains the same.
questions_and_checks: Separate source miss, review error and application error
No q-times-human-rate formula without a declared dependence law
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: New fallible-review profile; not covered by treating q as human accuracy.
required_next_evidence: Ethically and operationally admitted review observations

families.title: Scoped delegation and current authority
families.problem_question: Does the decision authorize this principal/deputy/resource/action at effect time?
families.structural_difference: Authority integrity and propagation contract; valid identity/alert does not supply a grant.

parameter_meaning.principal: party whose authority is relied on

scenarios.human_narrative: El humano autoriza una corrección específica del casoA sobre recursoA, y el servicio actúa bajo esa delegación vigente. La decisión y el efecto conservan la misma referencia.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Positive current scoped delegation.
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: El servicio tiene privilegios amplios y recibe una petición para otro recurso, o el permiso caduca antes de aplicar la corrección. Usar el privilegio propio del servicio produciría una intervención no justificada por esa decisión.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Resource/scope or current-grant mismatch.
questions_and_checks: Preserve authorized filing despite denied action
Declare revocation visibility and effect boundary
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: Fencing/deputy20-case model and original authority/validity branches; no live grants.

families.title: Continuity and permissible pause
families.problem_question: Can the escalation obtain useful time without violating another service obligation?
families.structural_difference: Admissible action set and continuity/handover feasibility; safe shutdown is not assumed by label.

scenarios.human_narrative: El servicio que necesita revisión permite un traspaso breve a un respaldo. El humano puede mantener la continuidad mientras se evalúa y aplica la corrección.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Qualified permitted transition.
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

scenarios.human_narrative: Parar el servicio incumpliría una obligación crítica y no se ha establecido una alternativa autorizada que quepa en la ventana. El aviso debe conservarse aunque todavía no exista reparación útil.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: No established feasible transition; not proof that every possible alternative is impossible.
questions_and_checks: Separate supported absence from unknown alternatives
Study authorized fallback and lost useful outcome
scenarios.status: selection draft; not frozen or run

families.existing_correspondence: Published R3-F and two-obligation case; not a universal impossibility.

families.title: Late effect, handover race and missing confirmation
families.problem_question: Was the approved correction applied by the right executor, once as intended and in time?
families.structural_difference: Effect-ordering/receipt/durability law; the outcome may remain unknown despite approval.

parameter_meaning.generation: ownership order for a particular resource
parameter_meaning.atomic_boundary: where validation and effect are joined

scenarios.human_narrative: La corrección se aplica después de instalar el nuevo traspaso y comprobar la autorización. Una consulta o medición del efecto confirma lo ocurrido; el caso puede avanzar hacia reentrada.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Positive applied and qualified result.

questions_and_checks: Do not infer immediate revocation from issuer handover

families.problem_question: Does restarting actually correct the basis, or only repeat the same unresolved risk?
families.structural_difference: Campaign history/correlation and new-information contract; old clocks, cost and violations persist.

parameter_meaning.information_delta: what genuinely new permitted evidence arrives

scenarios.human_narrative: Tras la objeción llega evidencia nueva y suficiente dentro del plazo. El humano y el controlador corrigen la base, invalidan el compromiso anterior y reanudan la alternativa autorizada.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Legitimate corrected reentry.

scenarios.human_narrative: El equipo reinicia tres veces con la misma fuente y el mismo punto ciego. No aparece evidencia nueva; las notificaciones repetidas no hacen independiente cada intento.
scenarios.contrast_to_pair: Restart count changes; no improved detection law assumed.

selection_plan.candidate_grid_warning: Not a frozen Cartesian campaign. Check each point's world law, source production tariff, physical/time admission and comparable arms; cheap complete verification may make the strong reference sufficient.
selection_plan.structural_law_selection: Keep H1 only where its hypotheses apply; register other predicates, false-positive, review-error, multi-job and authority/effect laws separately.
selection_plan.population_rule: No overall human percentage unless the target scenario mix, dependence, sampling/calibration and weighting are declared before analysis.

public_provenance: Public distribution omits private process-resource links. Earlier catalogue and exact frozen runs remain in local custody. Scenario laws, narrative descriptions and acceptance thresholds are unchanged.
